items.prompt: Why do 128 fast completed events not establish a production p99.99 guarantee?
items.modelAnswer: Small nonrepresentative sample/workload and few tail observations; need percentile convention, actual arrival/lag/rejections/timeouts, error accounting, observation interval/clock and representative load/platform. A sample empirical percentile is not a population/future bound, and omissions/backpressure can hide independent demand.
